Plan.md items 16-18. Depends on FEAT-001 and FEAT-002.

acceptance_criteria: npm test passes incl. P11 and render/audio/app unit tests
npm run preview serves a game where C adds a credit, Enter starts with 1 credit used, and game over reaches the Incident Report, initials and highscores without console errors

findings: Commit feat(app): renderer, audio and playable cabinet on main (not pushed). VERIFICATION: npm test 46 files / 472 tests green (incl. S1 guard, P11); npm run typecheck and npm run build exit 0 (bundle ~69 kB JS). Headless Playwright smoke (throwaway script in /tmp, deleted) against vite preview at 960x720: /?qa=1&seed=3735928559 -> C (credit 01) -> Enter (credit 00, READY) -> scripted arrows -> grant all 5 power-ups + releaseEnemies + setInvulnerable(600) (CloudWatch lines/outlines, Outage darkness, clone, shield ring, Lambda trail, CDN pads all visible) -> forceGameOver -> getScreen()==='incident' -> 70 frames -> Enter -> initials -> KIR+Enter -> highscores with KIR highlighted; and a plain run (no qa) that idles until the third natural death reaches the Incident Report ('LATENCY CAUGHT KIRO', DynamoDB fact). Zero console errors / page errors in both. A temporary vite-dev harness (deleted) drove a BFS bot through level clear 1 -> HALL-B level 2 -> clear -> HALL-C level 3 and a death; screenshots confirmed LEVEL CLEAR flash + bonus popup, READY banner, ghost-fade death. Without public/config.json, vite preview's HTML fallback serves index.html, so loadConfig logs 'offline mode: config.json is not valid JSON' (console.info, not an error) and the global panel shows OFFLINE. FILES: render/{palette,font,sprites,scale,gfx,view,hud,crt,renderer}.ts + screens/{attract,playing,incident,initials,highscores}.ts; audio/sfx.ts; app/{loop,a11y,qa,app,main}.ts; test-support/canvas.ts (recording fake 2D ctx). DESIGN NOTES for later FEATs: (1) src/app/app.ts holds the DOM-free cabinet app (createCabinetApp: keyDown/keyUp/step/setHidden/view/qaHost/idle) so the wiring is unit-tested (app.test.ts plays a real game to the Incident Report and checks the recorded inputLog passes validateReplay; online/offline/rejected/tainted paths). main.ts is only DOM glue. (2) Session gained `tainted` (reset by resetForNewGame); QA mutators set it. (3) QA API lives at window.__KIROMAN_QA__ = {grantPowerUp, releaseEnemies (sets pen releaseIn=0, release happens on the next step), setInvulnerable, forceGameOver, getScreen, getScore, getLastSubmission}; mutators return false unless the cabinet is on 'playing' with a non-gameOver game; grantPowerUp throws TypeError for unknown kinds. forceGameOver moves the cabinet to 'incident' synchronously (no frame wait needed, but waiting is harmless). getLastSubmission is set at game over, also for tainted games. (4) Audio: SoundName = cabinet SfxName + 'warp' | 'cloneSpawn' (AP-5.2 lists 11 sounds); soundsForEvents maps engine events (one eat per step, none on a death step). (5) The canvas is scaled with integerScale(innerWidth, innerHeight) per AP-1.1, so at 960x720 it is 3x (720 px tall) and the HTML controls legend sits below the fold; screenshot #screen (canvas + CRT) or #cabinet (Playwright extends element shots). (6) Render reads only; the renderer test draws every screen/phase through a fake ctx and asserts only KIRO-16 fillStyles, integer coordinates and no missing glyphs (gfx onMissingGlyph hook). (7) Loop uses a 1e-6 epsilon so 60 frames of 1000/60 ms give exactly 60 steps; >5 steps backlog is dropped. (8) Keyboard: createDirStack added to keyboard.ts; key repeats are ignored except directions and initials arrow navigation. Spec tasks ticked: arcade-presentation 1-6, 8; coin-credit 10-12; leaderboard 14; plan.md items 16-18. Arcade-presentation task 7 (scripts/screenshots.mjs + committed PNGs) remains for the headless-verification FEAT.
